messages:
maya_pm: ACME and Nimbus both pushed for a single Console 'cost + errors' launch item. We need a short spec and a clear launch gate matrix. Can we align quickly?

jordan_back: Agree. Core pieces: ingress price_id, route/feature tagging, daily materialized cost view, and a light trace-on-demand flow.

casey_ui: From UX POV: landing card, compare two routes/features side-by-side, a small explain widget for spikes, and CSV export. Keep it one-click for procurement.

ev an_sre: Ops constraints: any stored traces must be quota'd. Flagging idea: enable default route tags org-wide, traces opt-in per-org. Auto-disable sampling if CPU uplift >2.5% for 3 consecutive 5m windows.

sre-bot: Noted. Created feature flag entry: obs_cost_errors_beta. Auto-disable rule placeholder created.

maya_pm: Launch gates proposal (draft):
- Dev: feature complete + unit tests
- Perf: <1.5% median p99 latency delta with route tags enabled at 100%
- Storage: projected trace storage cost within threshold for 90-day retention
- Acceptance: two pilot customers (ACME, Nimbus) can run acceptance script and export CSV

jordan_back: We should be explicit about billing join semantics: snapshot price_id at ingress. Reconciliation doc required for finance.

casey_ui: Acceptance UX: pilot users must be able to filter by list-of-routes, view cost/day, error-rate/day, click an error point and request up to 5 traces. The export must include model_price_id column.

tara_qe: QA tests I'll own: cost calculation end-to-end with mid-window price changes, trace quota enforcement, CSV column validation, and UI responsiveness on 30-day aggregation queries.

ev an_sre: Risk list to surface to execs: instrumentation churn, unexpected telemetry volume, and billing disputes when prices change after ingest.

maya_pm: Mitigations: require pilot-provided route-mapping for beta, default sampling low (1% payloads), price snapshot at ingest, and 30d TTL for requested traces compressed.

jordan_back: Implementation phasing suggestion:
- Phase 0: route tags + price_id annotation (no traces stored) -> materialized daily cost view -> Console card (beta)
- Phase 1: on-demand traces with per-org quota + TTL -> extend Console drill path
- Phase 2: automated correlation and anomaly alerts (post-beta)

casey_ui: UX timeline: mocks for Phase 0 this week, Phase 1 flows next week. Will include a small "explain spike" microcopy for procurement decks.

ev an_sre: I'll draft the rollback playbook and alerts. Also add a metric that tracks orgs enabling trace fetch to detect abuse.

sre-bot: Alert rule created: "obs_cost_trace_quota_exceeded" -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-platform.

noel_sales: Sales ask: ACME wants a one-page PDF export with an explanation for spikes (token vs model vs volume) for procurement by end of Q2. Can we commit?

maya_pm: If we scope Phase 0 + export and get ACME mapping, yes. We'll call out Phase 1 (trace retention) as Q3.

jordan_back: Data model note: materialized view keyed by org, route_id, date, model_price_id. We'll keep price metadata for 90d for reconciliation.

casey_ui: CSV columns: org, route_id, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_id, model_price_id, unit_price_usd, cost_usd, error_count, p95_latency_ms. PDF export auto-generates a one-slide summary.

tara_qe: Performance acceptance: Phase 0 should not cause >1% median tail latency regression. We'll run A/B test on small subset of traffic.

ev an_sre: Also require feature flag gating per-org and ability to mute for specific orgs automatically if SLOs degrade.

sre-bot: Feature flag "obs_cost_errors_beta" created with per-org enablement and auto-disable hooks.

maya_pm: Owners recap: Product=maya_pm, Backend=jordan_back, UI=casey_ui, SRE=evan_sre, QA=tara_qe, Sales=noel_sales.

jordan_back: I'll open the ingest PR with price_id and materialized view schema by EOD.

casey_ui: I'll post Phase 0 mocks and the export sample in 48h.

tara_qe: I'll prepare acceptance test cases and a checklist for pilot signoff.

noel_sales: I'll coordinate ACME mapping CSV and procurement requirements.

maya_pm: Decision: ship Phase 0 gated beta for ACME + Nimbus by end of Q2 if mappings provided. Phase 1 targeted for Q3. I'll update roadmap and notify stakeholders. Closing thread; please file tickets for items above.
